name: Free Download Manager
description: 免费的下载管理器，多线程加速，支持 BT 和视频下载。
intro: Free Download Manager（FDM）是一款免费的下载管理器，支持多线程加速、断点续传、BT 下载和网页视频嗅探。界面简洁、没有广告，适合替代浏览器自带的下载功能。
highlights: 支持 BT 与磁力链接

en.name: Free Download Manager
en.description: Free download manager with multi-threaded acceleration, BT and video downloads.
en.intro: Free Download Manager (FDM) is a free download manager with multi-threaded acceleration, resume support, BitTorrent downloads and web video sniffing. It has a clean, ad-free interface and is a good replacement for the browser's built-in downloader.

name: XDown
description: 支持 BT、磁力和 HTTP 的多线程下载工具。
intro: XDown 是一款支持 HTTP、FTP、BT 和磁力链接的下载工具，支持多线程下载和断点续传，界面轻量。适合下载较大的安装包、影视资源和 BT 种子。

en.name: XDown
en.description: Multi-threaded downloader for BT, magnet and HTTP links.
en.intro: XDown is a download tool supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent and magnet links, with multi-threaded downloads and resume support. Its lightweight interface suits large installers, media files and torrents.

name: LMMS
description: 开源音乐制作软件，用来编曲、作曲和混音。
intro: LMMS 是一款开源的数字音频工作站，支持编曲、作曲、混音和 MIDI 编辑，内置多种合成器、鼓机和效果器。界面友好，适合入门音乐制作和电子音乐创作，完全免费。

en.name: LMMS
en.description: Open-source music production software for composing, arranging and mixing.
en.intro: LMMS is an open-source digital audio workstation for composing, arranging, mixing and MIDI editing, with built-in synthesizers, drum machines and effects. It is free and approachable for beginners and electronic music makers.

name: Krita
description: 专业的开源绘画软件，适合插画、漫画和概念设计。
intro: Krita 是一款专业的开源绘画软件，提供丰富的笔刷引擎、图层管理、动画和时间轴工具，适合插画、漫画、概念设计和数字绘画。完全免费，跨平台使用。

en.name: Krita
en.description: Professional open-source painting software for illustration and concept art.
en.intro: Krita is a professional open-source painting application with a rich brush engine, layer management, animation and timeline tools. It suits illustration, comics, concept art and digital painting, and is completely free.
